words.name: technique-effects
words.spec: A technique's `effects` list may hold {"name": <library Effect name>, "unlock_layer": n, "passive_art": true, "rule": ...}. When a build knows the technique at layer n or above (fight.py `tech_layers`, the GDScript FighterCompiler), the loader adds that Effect from assets/data/combat_effects.json and merges its counters. For Playing Past the Break, FighterCompiler also populates build.meters["playing_past_the_break"] = {"start": saved, "p": (than_hon + khi_van) / 400}. Matches Thiên Xu and Lạc Hà's pending word of the same name.
words.gdd_text: Công Pháp rule (passive arts & technique effects): a technique may carry named Effects with an unlock layer; known to that layer, the Effect is always on in a fight without taking an art slot.
used_by: Birds Pay Court to the Phoenix
